reviewed_by: Claude review of the interactive guides change (operator-approved Figma page "Guides")
reason: Adds in-app interactive guides: a Guides hub, a step card that spotlights the real control, Core-owned per-operator progress (guides.py, GuideProgress entity), a starter-files endpoint and an AGENTS.md probe. Anchors were added to Workbench, Settings and chat components, and hook/skill catalogs now refresh when the chat or Assistant settings come back into view. The selection covers the new Core module and entity registry, operator identity, hooks, operator help, every frontend component that gained an anchor or behavior, App integration, and the real-Core guide journeys (hook files, resume from Core, all assistant guides reaching their controls) on all eight assistant-real profiles plus the existing lifecycle-hooks real-Core journey.
exclusions: No full suites. Native: only the SIDECAR_ENV_ALLOWLIST constant gained three names; no sidecar test asserts the list and behavior is unchanged otherwise (verified locally with cargo test --locked sidecar: 8 passed). README/NEBULA3.md edits are documentation. The calm-CSS audit's pre-existing failures are in untouched files; guides.css passes it.
